statement: The required broad release-library test builds after restoring tracked sparse fixtures but is not an all-pass result: its already-failing full run was interrupted before completion, then all 41 recorded failed names were retried. After tracked fixture restoration, 32 pass and nine fail: five require archived session records, two require unavailable Linux time-namespace proc files, and two are unchanged registry assertions. No shared library source or archived dataset was patched; new candidate qualification is the separately registered no-timer result. This is a test-status assertion, not a speed measurement.
